questions.context: Noah says, “I need to know the place won’t be empty halfway through the year.”

options.text: The uncertainty of having an unoccupied property partway through the year
The prospect of having to change the rent halfway through an agreed term

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: The concern in this line is an occupancy gap, rather than changing the price of a term already agreed.

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: The concern in this line is an occupancy gap, rather than changing the price of a term already agreed.

questions.context: Ruby says, “Much as I like the apartment, I can only commit to six months.”

options.text: It presents six months as an opening offer that she is willing to exceed
It acknowledges the apartment’s appeal without relaxing her stated limit

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: She can appreciate the apartment and still limit her commitment to six months.

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: She can appreciate the apartment and still limit her commitment to six months.

questions.context: They discuss six months with an option to extend. Noah says, “Possibly, provided you let me know well in advance.”
questions.prompt: Which interpretation keeps the condition intact?

options.text: Advance notice is a condition of Noah considering an extension, not a guarantee of agreement
Adequate notice is enough to make the extension automatic on the original terms

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Provided introduces a condition. Possibly is not a guarantee of extension.

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Provided introduces a condition. Possibly is not a guarantee of extension.

questions.context: Noah agrees to keep the rent the same during the initial term, but cannot promise the same price for an extension.

options.text: The initial rent carries into the extension unless Ruby asks for a review
The initial term has a fixed rent; no price commitment has been made for the extension

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Do not extend a commitment beyond the time period the speaker actually accepted.

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Do not extend a commitment beyond the time period the speaker actually accepted.

questions.context: Ruby says, “My main concern is having a clear review date.” Noah replies, “Then let’s put that in writing.”
questions.prompt: Which revision would directly address Ruby’s concern?

options.text: Add an explicit review date to the written terms
Restate that notice must be given well in advance, leaving the date flexible

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: A written review date makes the timing explicit; a vague notice phrase does not supply a calendar date.

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: A written review date makes the timing explicit; a vague notice phrase does not supply a calendar date.

questions.context: Ruby wants flexibility. Noah needs continuity. They consider a six-month initial term, possible extension, notice and a written review date.
questions.prompt: Which summary avoids overstating the compromise?

options.text: They have settled both the initial term and extension, with only the paperwork outstanding
They have a workable basis for the initial term; the review arrangements and extension conditions still need precision

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: A compromise can protect both interests without implying unconditional agreement or a guaranteed extension.

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: A compromise can protect both interests without implying unconditional agreement or a guaranteed extension.

phrases.displayText: I understand why you’d prefer a twelve-month contract
phrases.translation: Entendo por que você prefere um contrato de doze meses

phrases.displayText: It gives me some certainty, especially with the maintenance costs
phrases.translation: Isso me dá alguma segurança, especialmente em relação aos custos de manutenção

phrases.displayText: Much as I like the apartment, I can only commit to six months
phrases.translation: Por mais que eu goste do apartamento, só posso me comprometer por seis meses

phrases.displayText: That’s difficult. I need to know the place won’t be empty halfway through the year
phrases.translation: Isso é difícil. Preciso ter certeza de que o local não ficará vazio no meio do ano

phrases.displayText: Would you consider six months with an option to extend?
phrases.translation: Você consideraria um contrato de seis meses com opção de prorrogação?

phrases.displayText: Possibly, provided you let me know well in advance
phrases.translation: Possivelmente, desde que me avise com bastante antecedência

phrases.displayText: That seems reasonable. The rent would also need to stay the same during the initial term
phrases.translation: Isso parece razoável. O aluguel também precisaria permanecer o mesmo durante o prazo inicial

phrases.displayText: I can agree to that, but I can’t promise the same price for the extension
phrases.translation: Concordo com isso, mas não posso prometer o mesmo preço para a extensão

phrases.displayText: Fair enough. My main concern is having a clear review date
phrases.translation: Entendo. Minha principal preocupação é ter uma data de revisão clara

phrases.displayText: Then let’s put that in writing
phrases.translation: Então vamos colocar isso por escrito

phrases.displayText: Good. We’ve both had to compromise, but the arrangement feels workable
phrases.translation: Ótimo. Ambos tivemos que ceder, mas o acordo parece viável

phrases.displayText: Agreed. I’ll send you the revised terms this afternoon
phrases.translation: Concordo. Enviarei os termos revisados esta tarde
